text_block_list.text:
It was when Hishi Amazon finished her 
racing outfit photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list:
What's wrong? You're staring intently at 
the church.

What's wrong? You're staring at the 
church.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it just reminded me of a wedding I 
saw in America when I was little!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Have you ever seen one, Trainy? ...A 
true, genuine 'partner'!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Receptions over there are lively affairs, 
you see. Everyone in the hall dances with 
a partner, but—

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... That was amazing, so 
amazing! Their movements... Their 
breathing was in total sync—"

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like we're in a world made just 
for the two of us...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back! After that, I dragged my 
brothers and sisters out to dance—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Nah, instead of dancing, I was 
swinging them all over the place, so it 
didn't go well at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! The photoshoot's done, so how 
about dancing with me?
choice_data_list:
Huh!? But I don't really know much about 
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all! I'll lead with the 
basic steps, so just follow my lead."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty. It should be fine to play music 
here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
First, take each other's hands. Then, 
place your hand on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three... Don't look down at your 
feet, keep your eyes right on me.

I somehow managed to keep up with her. 
Though my steps were clumsy at first, once 
I got the general hang of it—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! Your footwork's getting a lot 
smoother.

I learned to match her steps so that she 
could dance freely.

With every step she took, her tied hair 
swayed and swayed—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, not bad at all! I didn't think you 
could dance this well!

She gave me a passing grade. Nothing could 
make me happier. Because—
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to make you shine, too.
Because I wanted to help you shine too

text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a way that keeps this 
racing dress shining forever—she once said 
those words.

That's why I wanted to support her. So 
that Hishi Amazon's wish could truly come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see, no wonder it was so easy to lead. 
That's my Trainy for ya!

The trust conveyed through her words... It 
filled me with immense joy—
choice_data_list:
I'll always be by your side, supporting 
you.
I'll always be by your side to support you

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahahahahaha! Bring it on, then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'm holding you to what you 
said!
choice_data_list: Huh—whoa!

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, she grabbed my hand and began 
performing steps even more intricate than 
before!
choice_data_list: (Still, I'll make sure to match her...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nice! You're a Trainer through and 
through!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now, sink your teeth into it, partner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Not bad at all! To think you 
danced through the entire song.
choice_data_list:
Just keeping up with you... took 
everything I had...!

Just keeping up with you... took 
everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who said you'd support me 
forever, right? ...Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...That dance just now was amazing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I really wish I could show this to the me 
from back then, you know? Haha!

She gave me a passing grade. Nothing could

"...Still, keeping up with her dancing 
proved to be an arduous task—"
choice_data_list: Wah, w-whoa...!

text_block_list.text: (THUMP!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there...! Are you alright?! Did I 
swing you around too much?
choice_data_list: What about you, are you hurt or—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! I could keep dancing for 
songs on end. Though maybe we should wrap 
it up here. The time is—
choice_data_list: …Can't we keep going just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: Because I want to be able to support you.

Because I want to be someone who can 
support you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Haha! Is that so? You've got some 
serious guts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You already know the answer without me 
saying it, don't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.text:
Every time she fails... I take her hand 
and dance. Vowing in my heart that one 
day, I will guide her to even greater 
heights.

She gave me a passing grade. Nothing could 
make me happier. Because—
choice_data_list:
Because I want to stand 
shoulder-to-shoulder with you.

Because I want to stand shoulder to 
shoulder with you.

text_block_list.text:
If someone were ever in danger, she would 
surely step in without hesitation. Just 
like that day she went looking for Amazon 
Lily.

I want to be of help to her— I want to 
become a Trainer who can protect her.

"That is why I wished to dance in a way 
that would make her shine even brighter. 
To do that—"
choice_data_list: Mind if I take the lead this time?
May I take the lead this time?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh, Tre-dude wants me?

text_block_list.text:

kind of dance it'll be. I'm counting on 
you to escort me!

I'll take her by the hand and guide her so 
she can take the steps she truly wants 
to...!

text_block_list.text:

make for a great dance!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:

that!

I was able to dance to the end because you

text_block_list.text:
What're you talkin' about? It's 'cause you

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... This kind of thing isn't so bad

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:

would make Hishi Amazon shine, but—"
choice_data_list: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, not like that! Like, shifting your 
center of gravity, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You guide your partner like this. That 
way, you won't need to use unnecessary 
force—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh!? Before I knew it, I took 
the lead...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I just can't help myself when 
it comes to looking after others...
choice_data_list: One more time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: This time, I'll show you I can lead you!
This time, I will be the one to lead you!

text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's the spirit! That's how you 
gotta be!
